LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASS: COLLECTIVE NOUNS/ REFLEXIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you emphasise that you did something on your own?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts
2. use collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns

Teach
• Focus skill: identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you emphasise that you did something on your own?
2. Which words do you use to refer to a group of things or animals?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
